title: ScanProcessMemory underflows loop bound and can over-read scanBuffer
summary: The scan loop uses `bytesCopied - patternSize` without validating that the copied chunk is at least as large as the pattern.
impact: A short chunk can underflow the loop bound and drive out-of-bounds reads from a 4 KB stack buffer in kernel mode.

title: C# response decoding is broken for read-style operations
summary: GetResponseBytes copies from a `ulong[]` into a `byte[]` with Array.Copy, which is not a valid byte-level serialization strategy.
impact: CLI read flows can throw at runtime instead of showing returned data.

title: ReadWithProtect fails to restore original page protection on one error path
summary: After changing a region to PAGE_EXECUTE_READWRITE, the function returns early on PsLookupProcessByProcessId failure without restoring the old protection.
impact: A failed request can leave target memory more permissive than intended.

title: Silent-mode state races across concurrent requests
summary: Per-request logging state is stored in a shared global boolean and overwritten in dispatch before each request runs.
impact: Parallel requests can interfere with each other's logging behavior.
